reviewer: isolated reviewer agent /root/ps3_pdf_review, fresh Xbox 360 review

review_scope.method: Independently read content.json brief/preserve and Kami delivery coverage log, opened all 12 page PNGs using view_image, and inspected PDF page sizes and actual SHA256. No desktop actions, CAD changes or regeneration.
review_scope.limitations: Presentation and consistency with supplied brief only. Native CAD reload, BRep section-generation correctness, full component-ID correspondence across CAD/STEP/web, and historical hardware/source accuracy were not independently reproduced or re-audited.

acceptance_results.delivery_log: READY, 0 errors, 1 orphan warning, 0 gaps. Content coverage, fonts, density, placeholders and page count reported OK.
acceptance_results.visual: All pages individually inspected. No P0/P1 clipping, label overlap, missing glyphs, stranded headings, split tables, or blocking unreadability observed. Dimensions and captions fit their panels.
acceptance_results.preserve: Visible text/figures retain original non-HDMI Xenon, removable 20 GB drive, 2005 wireless controller with separate RF board, unequal motors and two AA cells, controller-end headset volume/mute adapter, 203 W supply, six-RCA AV cable, LAN and grounded North-American AC. Short display cables and approximate/nonfunctional internals are clearly stated.
acceptance_results.counts: 35 source stages, 2005 component entries and 3141 solids are consistent on pages 1 and 12; page 11 keeps entries distinct from solids.
acceptance_results.specific_checks: Page 7 title and motherboard views are unobstructed. Page 8 power-supply internals and dimension are visible. Page 9 separately captions and shows controller front input and rear control/RF views.
acceptance_results.geometry_limit: CAD-derived projections and physical sections are presented and labeled, but native model-derived dimension reload was not re-tested in this visual review.

findings.finding: At the labeled 0.142:1 scale, cable connector details are small relative to available panel area. Cable families and six RCA ends remain distinguishable, and the AV connector is enlarged separately below; nonblocking for this study booklet.
The flagged titles/table header are visibly attached to their page content. No stranded heading or split table was found.
